title: Ledger and Portrait
author: Theo Ravensworth
blurb: Silas Dravenmoor, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
